entities.summary: Andrei Galbur is a Moldovan former politician and diplomat. He served as Deputy Prime Minister, Minister of Foreign Affairs and European Integration in Prime Minister Pavel Filip's cabinet. Previously Galbur served as Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs and European Integration (2015–2016), and Ambassador of Moldova to Russia (2013–2015).
